Rooms.Name: #MThe Gates of Zia#N
Rooms.Description:
Awe is what you feel, standing in front of these truly gigantic 
gates, which burn perpetually, keeping those not of Phos from entering 
our sacred refuge. The burning spires tower high above you, seeming to 
singe the clouds and reach for the sun in their marvelous grandeur. 
Amazingly, the spectacular gates are only the beginning of the wonders 
that await you when you enter our sacred fold.

Rooms.Name: #MDen of the Eclipse#N
Rooms.Description:
The first thing that catches your eye as you enter this immense 
dining room for the followers of Phos is a monstrous marble dining 
table. Each of our esteemed brothers and sisters claims a seat, where 
we discuss our exploits and drink wine until Phos shines upon us once 
again. Richly dark oak pillars stand around the table, and huge fires 
remind us of our Lord when he is away blessing others. A #Ygolden 
#Yplaque#N hangs on the eastern wall. Thick rugs and furs invite you 
to remove your heavy boots and sit for a spell, and talk amongst 
yourselves.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
#yThe Founding Members of #MDragoons #wof #CPhos#N
Ix, Kurrelgyre, Ambryl, Purr, Chani, Tsunami, Wick, Hylar, 
Kieriay, Colosul, Aynjul, Jura, Rage, Ragnar, Nermal, Garf, 
Prophator, Redfang, Snarf
#yMay the Sun shine upon you wherever you may go.#N

Rooms.Name: #MPhos' High Altar#N
Rooms.Description:
This dedication to our god, Phos, is an immense room with a dome made 
of stained glass. The entire room is golden with the light of our 
beloved Lord of the Sun. Even at night, the room still emanates a warm 
glow, a gift given to his chosen ones by our benevolent Lord. The walls 
glitter with elaborate tapestries of silk, glittering weapons, and 
gilded icons showing our faith. A very warm feeling of replenishment 
flows through your veins as you stand here, for the light from above 
invigorates your weary body. Rest here and Phos will watch over you. 
There is also anther #MShelf #wof #CPhos#N here where we can put items 
that might help you but are not worth enter the #MDragoon Trove#N.

Rooms.Name: #MDragoon Trove#N
Rooms.Description:
In this room, our brethren leave important items for communal use. 
There is also a #MShelf #wof #CPhos#N where you can place items you find 
you cant drop. Take what you wish, but try to return it once no more 
can be gleaned from it. Another dragoon may find use of it, and the 
favor shall come back to you.

Rooms.Name: #MBurning Den#N
Rooms.Description:
Warmth encompasses your body as you enter the den. A hearth heats the 
entire room, and fire pits lie spitting and hissing in the Four Corners 
of the room. Two enormous couches sit facing each other, large enough 
to accommodate all the Dragoons and then some. A thick slab of redwood 
serves as a table and a footrest, and engraved mugs of pewter lie 
scattered and empty. While the dining room serves the more serious and 
formal matters, this room is designed purely for comfort. This is also 
where the Dragoons hone their battle skills, so as not forget the reason 
they banded together. They will always remain exceptional warriors.

Rooms.Name: #MA Phos Hallway#N
Rooms.Description:
This is a long hallway that expands to the east. From this hallway 
you can get to many different rooms of the #MDragoon's#N.

Rooms.Name: #MSith's Shrine Of '#RCore#N
Rooms.Description:
As you enter this room, you get the inexplicable urge to Skank. And 
in the background you notice a feverish, up-beat guitar, a melodic, and 
moving baseline which is amplified in effect by a set of horns 
(Trombone, and alto and Bari sax), a throbbing drumbeat, that all 
intertwine behind a blaring set of vocal chords, screaming the anthem 
"We're not gonna take it!" After finally getting adjusted to the music 
of the room, you notice the shape of this "room", it is round, with no 
corners and one visible face that surrounds and encompasses the viewer 
with a #Rmural#N painted onto this surface, the floor is of hard wood 
and slanted at various angles to give a mesmerizing effect if one were 
to stare at it for too long. Along this wall above the mural are many 
various guitars, with a white Yamaha bass as the centerpiece to them 
all. Along the side opposite the door is a stack of speakers resembling 
an amplifier of some sort, the section of floor under this area is 
raised to be a bit higher than that of the rest of the room. To the 
near side of the room are a couple of chairs and couches, with a bed 
resting on two red trunks on the area to the right, just before the 
stage.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This mural depicts 4 men. The first one an older man with a blonde 
receding hairline, he has a big nose and an awkward grin on his face, 
as if he has just done something wrong. The second man is much shorter 
than the first and is wearing allot of necklaces and bracelets. In his 
right hand he holds a paints brush still dripping with red paint. The 
third man is slightly taller than the second, he is very thin and looks 
about as old as the second (but in all reality is not), on his head he 
wears a hat that bears an iron cross on the backside (since he is 
wearing it backwards, that is the side facing), on his right hand in a 
watch, and in the hand is a piece of glass. The fourth and final man is 
the same height as the third, although this man carries a much larger 
and muscular build. He wears a pair of china blue shoes, and on his face 
are the thickest pair of glasses you have ever seen in your life. 
Attached to his shirt in some fashion is some sort of watch, it 
resembles a grandfather clock's face only smaller. The four men look 
confident and indomitable. As you continue to stare at the painting, the 
picture shifts and the men's appearances change, all the while under 
close scrutiny, one can notice other shapes fall in behind the four men, 
some ever seem to stand along side the four. But the only real 
noticeable difference is that the second man seems to have a dark shadow 
over him, and all that look upon this know something has gone awry. The 
only signature to be found on the painting is that of and "S" with two 
vertical lines running through it.

This is a standard issue white Yamaha bass model kpx250 along the neck 
is written the words "#Rfor Stan#N".

Rooms.Name: #MA Phos  Hallway#N
Rooms.Description:
This is a long hallway that expands to the east. From this hallway 
you can get to many different rooms of the #MDragoon's#N.

Rooms.Name: #MThe Hall of Rememberence#N
Rooms.Description:
As you step into this room you get the feeling that things here are 
calmer, more peaceful then in the hustle and bustle of the normal rooms. 
As you peer around you see that this hallway leads to the rooms of our 
long departed but honored #MPhos#N.

Rooms.Name: #MA Phos  Hallway#N
Rooms.Description:
This is a long hallway that expands to the west. From this hallway 
you can get to many different rooms of the #MDragoon's#N.

Rooms.Name: #MThe Hall of Gods#N
Rooms.Description:
Amongst these sacred halls lay the rooms of Gods both past and
present who were either members of #MD#wo#CP#N or held by the clan in high
regards for their wisdom and advice. #MD#wo#CP#N salutes and remembers those who
gave unselfishly if their time and energy to create and rule in this
land we call #bElitemud#N!

Rooms.Name: #MThe Library#N
Rooms.Description:
As you walk in this great room you realize that this is where the 
#MDragoon#e'#Ms#N come to read the important information being passed down from 
member to member. As you stand in the center you get the feeling that 
there is something different about this room. Its not just that huge 
writing board in the center that #MPhos#N use to pass on information. 
You walk to the center of the room and look up and see a huge 
#Cskylight#N that allows the sun and moon alike to let their rays of 
light into this great hall. Just as you are about to leave this room 
it finally comes to you what is so different about this place. This 
room is devoid of any sound.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look up you gaze in awe at the beauty of the skylight directly 
above you. 20 feet in diameter, this giant dome fills the room with the 
glory of the #yday#N and the beauty of the #Bnight#N. It seems to you 
that there is nothing between you and the #bsky#N above.

Rooms.Name: #MThe Waiting Room#N
Rooms.Description:
As you descend from the #MDragoon Trove#N you realize at once that
this isn't an ordinary room. You get the impression that your being
watched by more then #gMercedes#N the secretary at the center of the room.
You quickly scan the room and see a door to the #Gnorth#N and #Rsouth#N.
Each door has a name over it. There are also quite a few #Bpictures of
beautiful naked women#N on the walls in addition to a #Cstatue#N in the
north corner of the room. Strangely enough there are #Mchairs#N on the
West Side of the room. As you attempt to step towards one of the doors
the secretary blocks your way and points to the south corner of the of
the room where there is a #Csign#N.

Exits.Description:
have an appointment, you will just have 
to sit and wait.

the heat of the day, 
or when da Wolf seeks #Bnight#N, the glass ceiling darkens until the 
room has the comfort of a shaded spot in a deep #Gforest#N or a cave 
buried in the face of a mountain. The roof slants gradually from its 
peak 20 feet up the side of the tree to a bare 8 inches from the thick 
dark green moss, which cushions the floor. A very fine screen forms 
the short remaining wall. The mesh seems to disappear when you attempt 
to look closely at it. A bubbling stream fills the pond at the center 
of the room, and the force of the water forms a small magical 
#Bfountain#N that seems to be altered.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Ashlyn's measurements are 34C-22-33 and five foot-three inches tall, 
with shapely legs, a beautifully round ass and breasts that are enticing 
mounds of flesh standing erect. Ashlyn is simply stunning.

Briana is a beautiful blonde, wild, who seems born to be a model. She 
has a 34DD-26-30 figure and long, blonde hair.

As you check out these comfortable leather chairs you realize that you 
may have a long wait before you gain entry into XeNos's and Fistandantilus
rooms.

This is a statue of Kaitlyn our most precious prize. This buxom blonde 
statue is a long legged seducer that boasts a stellar 34D-24-35 figure 
at 5'5''.

Really some fabulous trees, a holdout from the Cretaceous or Pleistocene 
prehistoric time. The Redwood is the world's tallest known tree and one 
of the world's oldest trees. This tree, is nine hundred years old, 
stands 360 feet tall and has a diameter of 15 feet. Redwoods are named 
for the color of their bark and heartwood. The high tannin content of 
the wood gives the trees remarkable resistance to fungus diseases and 
insect infestations. The thick, fibrous bark has an even higher tannin 
content, and insulates them from the periodic fires which have occurred 
naturally down through the centuries. This immense tree has delicate 
foliage. Narrow, sharp-pointed needles only one-half to three-quarters 
of an inch long grow flat along their stems, forming feathery sprays. 
The cones are about an inch long and each cone contains fourteen to 
twenty-four tiny seeds

As you look at the ratton basket chairs you see it's made of wicker with 
very thick reeds instead of thin ones and is almost enclosed on three 
sides.

As you look up into the night you see a vivid display. The night shines 
with the light of the moon and the stars. It is indeed a beautiful site.

Rooms.Name: #MFistandantilus Room of Honor#N
Rooms.Description:
In this room full of pillage and plunder #MD#wo#CP#N honors one of their own.
The wonderfully awesome spectacular Fistandantilus whose aliases have 
been known to include Darklord, Hawkeye... and the list goes on and on.
This fearless warrior will wipe out entire zones of monsters without
even blinking an eye. This is where he plans out his mass killing sprees
so that the they can be executed to perfection since nothing less than
perfection will do. Just take a look around the room and admire and
look in awe of at all of his trophies and prizes. The one we know as
Fistandantilus is an admired #MD#wo#CP#N Council member.

Rooms.Name: #MThe Store#N
Rooms.Description:
This is where all #MPhos#N come to do their business. As you can see 
you can buy things from the nice merchant. In addition you can do 
banking in case you have too much or too little cash on hand. As you 
look around you notice a small sign on the wall.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a place of business. I will not tolerate any violence or 
stealing in my shop. Violators will be punished to the full extent of 
the law!

Rooms.Name: #MThrone of the Eclipse Lord#N
Rooms.Description:
Closest to Phos is Kurrelgyre, Lord of the Eclipse, and co-founder of 
our wondrous clan. His gilded throne sits here, lined with plush satin 
cushions and endowed with a regal glow. A spire of light illuminates the 
center of the room, piercing through a round window cut from diamond and 
placed directly above the throne. This serves as a constant reminder of 
Kurrelgyre's Lord, and his dedication to the #MDragoons #wof#C Phos#N.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you examine the throne more closely, the glare seems to subside and 
you see small, ornate etchings. Reading them more closely, you see the 
names of the mercenaries who embrace Phos.

Rooms.Name: #MIx's Humble Abode#N
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small, but ever expanding room. On the walls, 
you see great artwork, which was obviously stolen from art galleries 
around the world. The room is very cozy and you feel right at home.

Rooms.Name: #MAynjul's Playroom#N
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a room that appears to be completely white. Upon 
closer inspection, you realize that you are surrounded on all sides by 
walls made of moving clouds. The white, fluffy clouds and cool, blowing 
breeze in this room give it a peaceful and relaxing feel. As you turn 
around to get a better look at the rest of the room, you notice a black 
kitten sitting on top of a smaller, stationary cloud just above your 
head looking down ready to pounce!

Rooms.Name: #MGarf and Ragnar's Room#N
Rooms.Description:
This is a not so small room for two people. It has the standard 
equipment; two desks, two closets, a weapons rack and of course a finely 
carved four-poster canopy bed. The heavy oak desk obviously belongs to 
Ragnar as there is an axe holding down a sheet of paper. The other 
lighter desk just has to belong to Garf. The weapons rack has the 
standard tools of the trade locked up in it; a couple of swords, an axe 
or two, and of course a bow with a quiver of arrows A sign at the door 
says: "Wipe Your Feet the rug costs money"

Rooms.Name: #MKeldron's Swinging Pad#N
Rooms.Description:
As you walk into this room the eerie glow of 30 lava lamps surrounds 
you. You smell a faint trace of reefer and notice the bright colors on 
the walls. Over the door hangs a sign proclaiming #r"FREE LOVE MAN!" #N
There is a bean bag chair in the corner and a large flower shaped carpet 
in the middle of the room. The resident has posted several Woodstock 
posters on the wall and there is a stack of records up to waist level 
in the corner. You decide to take a seat and the lights dim and a Jimmy 
Hendrix record begins playing. "Hmm..." you think to yourself, "what a 
swinging pad."

Rooms.Name: #MHarlan's Conservatory#N
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a place of learning and growth. In this room, Harlan 
studies and cultivates the art of creating music. In the center of the 
room, you see a beautiful #rpiano#N, superbly crafted from ebony. There 
are various other musical instruments surrounding it. Along the west 
wall, many large bookcases made of a dark wood stretch toward the 
ceiling, filled with stacks of handwritten scores. As your eyes follow 
the them upward, you see several large skylights that allow the sultry 
glow of dusk to saturate the room. In the southern stretch of the room, 
you see a huge #bbed#N adorned in fine silk. Beside it is a small 
wooden table. Looking to the north, you see a small area of the floor 
crowded with overstuffed beanbag chairs. It looks like a nice place to 
relax for a while. There are many #gplants#N striving in stone pots all 
around it. You feel a sense of peace and healing here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is a fine instrument, unlike any you have seen. The whole piano seems 
to quietly emanate the emotion that has been poured into it. Its lid is 
propped open, revealing the work of a master craftsman. The is a small 
engraving in the sound board that reads: "Without music, life would be a 
mistake." - Nietzsche

The bed is large and round, about ten feet across. The sheets, a cobalt 
pool of silk, are in disarray. There are pillows strewn about the bed 
and the floor around it. The scent of a woman lingers in the air here.

The plants appear to be a fine strain of cannabis sativa. 
They are robust and fragrant.

Rooms.Name: #wMinas #gLus#yi#rtania#N
Rooms.Description:
You feel a sense of quietness as you enter this room. A dim light 
comes from the walls and a soft tone fills the place. Lying on the 
floor you find a #bbagpipe#N and a #brecorder#N among other musical 
instruments. On a desk some unfinished music scores wait the 
inspiration of their creator. At the other end some rather #Mqueer 
shelves#N keep #bbooks#N and #bscrolls#N of all sizes and for all 
ocasions just next to bottles containing liquids of bizarre colours 
and smells. On a heavy table rests a wizard hat and a wand seeming to 
move with own life. Levitating over a shiny mirror there is a 
#Mplaque#N reading in some weird language.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:

#MAvariel #CPrivate #NLibrary
Tacking a fast look the shelves you see large books, small books, 
weird books with wood covers, elegant books with fine worked leather 
covers, scrolls with strange symbols, bottles filled with exotic 
fluids, multiple flasks containing arcane ingredients. You try to get 
one book out, but when you touch it you feel a pain in the soul that 
force you to drop it. A voice in you head warns you that you're not 
allowed to take that book. You take another look trying to find 
something without a protective aura and your eyes stop in one name 
that you recognize. In one of the books you read '#MThe book of 
Shadows#N by #bAvariel the Warmage#N'. This must be the famous 
library of the migthy wizard.

The #MBook #Cof #NShadows by #MAvariel the Warmage#N
You see a large book with letters and magic symbols of gold and a 
purple silk cover. The book of shadows is more then a spell book, is 
the diary of the wizards progress in the art of magic, were he 
register his thoughs, his visions and his spells. The book is the 
Warmage greater treasure and this one is protected with several
spells that gives it a strange aura of many colours, a aura that keep 
the nosy folks away.

The #MBagpipe #Cof #NWarsongs
The #bbagpipe#N is decorated by a symbol in silver blue from an 
ancient celtic village. It looks as if music comes from it calling 
you to battle. #CGood luck to your quest!#N

#MPalantir#C's #Nrecorder
This #rrecorder#N appears to be very precious indeed to its owner. It 
is as shiny as if it was polished today and it is placed on soft red 
silk. Picking it up and blowing a tune you hear the rumble of a 
thousand warrior coming to help you.

Rooms.Name: #MSamas' #NSecret #CPalace#N
Rooms.Description:
As enter you notice two haunting golden #Cknights#N on each side of 
the platinum door. You begin to question your existence in such a room 
and start to quiver. However, you begin to hear an inviting chant coming 
from the slaved #Cmonks#N in the corner of the palace. Further in 
tapestries align the walls in a soothing manner. You no longer feel 
apprehension of being lost. You begin to wonder what type of wealth can 
purchase and decorate a room with such soothing discipline. Samas is a 
man of power, deception, and care for his fellow clannies. However, you 
will begin to notice in your stay that there is no expectance of his 
return. A journeyman and nomad, Samas rarely is present in his own 
palace. To the contrary, he has filled this room with gold, herbs, and 
riches to express his wealth and share it with other #MD#wo#CP#N members. You 
now figure that after staying in such wealth for a few hours, it is time 
to leave. You take one last sniff of power and exterminate your 
existence. Wait... what was that? Who was watching you gazing the riches? 
You run out more quickly than you entered.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The knight statues, made of the purest gold, diamonds, and platinum, are 
created after darkest days of Elite. Built much like the guardians of 
the ancient Elite Clan, these enormous statues can scare even the second 
toughest warrior of Elite. The only fighter not tainted by their evil 
looks is the owner of this room, Samas. The great sculptor, Michelangelo 
is the artist of these two massive golden pieces. Their value is 
priceless and the shear wonder of how Samas could purchase one, let 
alone two, is an unknown myth.

Hailing from the most secluded mountains of Tibet, these ancient 
Buddhist monks are skilled in the art of muteness and chanting. They all 
have ridded of material needs which makes their presence in this room 
of wealth a wonder in itself. The average value of a monk on the slave 
market is nearly 50m, but as you well know, this is pocket change to the 
great and powerful

Rooms.Name: #MWab#No's D#Cojo#N
Rooms.Description:
When you walk in to the #CDojo#N you see Wabo in his #wwhite#N 
judogi. And you notice that he knows exactly what to do on the 
#gtatami#N. Wabo looks at you and tells you 'Hey come on join the 
fun!' and #ySmiles#N next to the #gtatami#N you see a table with 
a #bTV#N on it, and in front of the table you see a #rBIG#N fluffy 
#mBED#N and in the corner a Pool table. What a nice place to 
#CRELAX#N in.

Rooms.Name: #rPuma#e'#rs#e #rA#ercane #rS#eanctuary#N
Rooms.Description:
This magical room is filled with thin #egrey#N mist. The walls are 
covered in ancient #yglowing#N #Crunes#N, and there is a round #eblack#N 
table in the middle of the room, filled with different #Gscrolls#N and 
#Mpotions#N. Then you feel like you are being watched, when you turn 
around you see a little #bImp#N looking up at you. Then you realize that 
there are #rmages#N living here, when you sit down you feel a #Rwarm 
#Gfeeling#N flow though you, and you feel #Bsafe#N here

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This little Imp is like all other Imps, short, annoying and loyal to his 
Mage. He looks at you, examining you equipment.

These strange Runes glow with a #rred#N light, they are from an ancient 
order of mages. They seem to heal your wounds quicker.

Rooms.Name: #CHigh #Ntower #Mroom#N
Rooms.Description:
This is where the mighty dweomer master #CGlobal #Nspends his time
when he doesn't level or is helping other clan members. In his room he
has a lot of books witch contain magic formulas and the history of other
masters and the history of other clans. There is many other stuffs in his
tower room too, he has a small bed where he sleeps and at the wall there
is a large chest with his clothes. At the right side of the window there
is a big fire barrel witch he can use to see great distances. There is 4
statues in here, one of the Greatest Dweomer master Nevyn, the wise elf
Dallandra, Aderyn when he is in his owl shape ready to take off and Jill´s
most loved warrior Rhodry. And on the left side on the wall beside the
window there is a picture of the dragon Arzosah Sothy Lorezohaz.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
You look at a chest on the floor witch contains all the stuffs that 
Global has been collecting under all these years. In the chest you
see a many herbs and clothes, even some weapons is lying in the 
chest.

Here stands Nevyn a great dweomer master, he is holding his staff and 
he is wearing a large coat.

Here is one of the mighty elven dweomer master named Dallandra, she was
Aderyns husband before got contact with the Guardians witch took her to
their world where the time passed much slower then in the land that
Aderyn lives in. She is wearing a coat and backpack, and she is sitting
on a horse.

You want to #rscream#N when you see him in this mood, hes is ready for
a fight and he is already berzerking, with his laugh you just want to
flee far away from him.

Arzosah is a huge black dragon who lives far up in the mountains among
the volcanos, so she can keep warm all the long winter. The only one
that can control her is the one who has the #wsilverring#N. And the one
who has it now is Rhordry.

He is a kind of strange elf, because he looks like an owl. But he is just
as mighty as all the other Dweomer masters.

Rooms.Name: #MAdara's abode#N
Rooms.Description:
As you walk in this room you immediately smell the #mevocative#N
fragrance of the perfume Adara wears. The apparent source seems to be a
#rrose#N lying on the farthest wall. The wallpaper of the room is pink and
speckled with flowers. There is a marble statue of #MPhos#N in a corner
surrounded by perpetually burning candles. Adara's #Ycomfy bed#N is in the
center of the room with her clothes spread all over it. There is also a
portrait of Adara's true love, that #Cmagically#N changes when her heart
changes. A small #egrey#N kitten with #gbright eyes#N leaps toward you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is an elegant #egrey#N kitten with #gbright eyes#N and black
stripes down his sides with one long magnificent black stripe from the
tip of his tail to the top of his head. You can't help but to draw in a
breath and just take in this magnificent creature, its somehow #Cmagical#N.

As you gaze upon this rose, the redness of the petals enchants you and
draws you into it and fills you with its scent which causes you to smile
and feel loved.

Rooms.Name: #MRoom of Gilian#N
Rooms.Description:
This is not a big room, it looks like a trophy room or something like 
that. On the North wall you see a lot of heads hanging. Mostly orcs 
(from Moria), but there I also saw other evil creatures hanging there. 
You see a sign that says "Balrog". But the balrog doesn't seem to be 
there. On the East wall there is lots of equipment (also from Moria) 
hanging, nothing interesting. On the right side of the door you see 
three stuffed horses. When you look at the first one you see that it is 
a brown colored, fat horse (it looks very lazy). The second is also 
brown, but this one looks underfed, not very nice. When you take a 
closer look on the third horse you see a very muscular white colored 
horse. A very fine horse (it looks like a fake). On the West Side of 
the room you see a very large, blue and white colored bed. Beside it 
lies a #Mnote#N. On the bed you see a small note.
Above the bed is a big #Mpainting #wof four #Cbards#N.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is my Hästens bed and it was very expensive so do not touch!

The four bards are Hansi Kursh, Andre Olbrich, Markus Siepen and Thomen 
Stauch. These four bards have wandered together in a very long time. 
They call themselves The Blind Guardians.

Rooms.Description:
This is a long hallway that expands to the east. From this hallway

This is a long hallway that expands to the west. From this hallway

This is a long hallway that expands to the west. From this hallway

Rooms.Name: #MLoomin's Throne Room#N
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the room of Loomin, the mighty warrior. The first
thing that catches your eyes is a big map on the southern wall. It
shows what the world looked like a long time ago when the world was 
still new. You also see a different collection of all kinds of ancient 
weapons and armours. He has saved them during the ages, and when he some
day in the future retires, he will write a history book about armour and
weapons, and how they have developed through the ages.
#GLoomin's Large golden breast plate lies here
A staff of magic lies here
Loomin's Journal lies here
A #yGolden #GDagger lies here

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
#MOn this armour, you see a banner from a clan long lost.
#CYou can still see the marks of #eswords#C on it.
This is a #MM#Ca#Mg#Ci#Mc#Ca#Ml #wstaff it can only be used by its original owner #ML#Coomi#Mn.

This ancient dagger is made out of pure gold. It was once made by the
hands of an elder priest, to be used in ceremonies. It still keeps
the memory of ancient rituals and sacrifises alive.

Rooms.Name: #MThe #cSizzling #MChamber#N
Rooms.Description:
As you step into the glowing chamber, your eyes immediately hurt from
a blazing #wsphere#N of white light just in the middle of the room. This
is the recharging room of the being known as #cBalefire#N. There are no
furniture or other objects in the room, for what chairs does a fiery
entity need? When the thing isn't roaming the lands, you can be sure it
is either recharging close to the giant sphere, or it has withdrawn into
it completely. Should it be in this room and regaining lost energy, be
sure to keep away from the uncontrolled bursts of fire which sometimes 
emerges from it's body, as they can kill even before they reach home.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A ball of electricity, that  now and then strikes out bursts of pure
energy. If you feel your hairs are starting to stand straight out, you're
standing too close.

Mobs.Name: attendant immortal shopkeeper DOPclan
Mobs.LongDescription: The Immortal Attendant lives only to serve you.
Mobs.Description:
The Attendant is humanoid in shape, with sallow grey skin, and
large black eyes. He looks at you with a mixture of awe and 
fear. He has been brought across space and time by the rulers 
of the #MDragoons #wof #CPhos#N to serve their clan for eternity.

Objects.Description: An automatic teller machine has been installed in the wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a small note on the machine which says:

To use, type "BALANCE", "WITHDRAW x", or "DEPOSIT x".  Please report any
strange occurrences to the bank manager.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large fountain carved from blue-streaked marble is here, bubbling
merrily. It is a well-crafted fountain, carved from a single piece
of marble. It seems to be enchanted in some manner.

Objects.Name: dragoon dragoons gate
Objects.Description:
An immense flaming gate stands here, flanked by equally impressive
statues of Kurrelgyre and Ix.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: #MA deep shelf, carved with hundreds of dragons, lies at your feet.#N

Mercedes is a stunning women. This buxom blonde is a long legged
seducer that boasts a stellar 36-24-36 figure at 5'5'' with bold green
eyes. As you star into those eyes you are lost and almost forget that
you are here to see XeNos and Fistandantilus. She gestures to the chairs
and the sign, and calmly states you may use either or both.
